Product Details: This versatile extension board is the perfect solution for powering multiple devices at once in your home or office. Featuring 6 universal sockets, each paired with its own individual red rocker switch, you can easily control power to each connected device independently — a highly convenient feature that helps save energy. A master switch with indicator light provides overall control at a glance. The universal socket design is compatible with a wide range of plug types, making it suitable for TVs, printers, scanners, LED lights, set-top boxes, music systems, emergency lights, and more. Rated at 6A and 240V, it comes with a generous length of white cable and a standard Indian 3-pin plug for a secure connection. The back panel features keyhole slots for easy wall mounting, keeping your workspace neat and tidy. Built with sturdy white casing, this extension board is a reliable and practical addition to any home or workplace setup.
